newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Nov fixed asset investment up 19.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Nov fixed asset investment up 19.2 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment rose 19.2 percent in January to November compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Wednesday.
The total figure of completed fixed asset investment was 1,088.9 billion yuan for the first 11 months, it said.
Investment in basic infrastucture climbed 11.6 percent over the period while investment in equipment upgrading rose by 16.2 percent and real estate surged by 36.7 percent, it said.
Investment in fixed assets rose by 18.6 percent in January-October. The growth rate for the first 10 months was down 0.6 percentage point from the same period last year.
The bureau cited a relatively low proportion of investment in technical upgrade as one area of concern.
